name: BAH 2026: Student–Teacher Knowledge Distillation for GAN-Based Cloud Removal
about: Entry to finals at BAH hackathon. Performs knowledge distillation from teacher model with LUPI (learning using privileged information); student trained on indigenous satellite data lacking an independent channel to replicate teacher results. Domain adaptation from Sentinel to LISS-IV (on Indian data) for student model.
tagline: knowledge distillation for indigenous satellite cloud removal.
description: Grand finalist at BAH 2026: student model on indigenous satellite data replicates a privileged teacher using a hallucination module and feature extraction
